mechanism_narrative: An increase in the federal funds rate by more than 0.25% within a month signals a tightening monetary policy, which typically leads to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days as borrowing costs rise and economic activity slows.
failure_condition: If the 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 40% of the instances when FEDFUNDS increases by more than 0.25% within a month.

mechanism_narrative: A significant drop in the unemployment rate (UNRATE) by more than 0.5% within two months signals a strengthening labor market, which typically leads to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days as consumer confidence and spending increase.
failure_condition: If the 5-day forward returns are negative in more than 60% of the instances when UNRATE decreases by more than 0.5% within two months.

mechanism_narrative: A sharp increase in housing starts (HOUST) by more than 5% within two months signals a strengthening demand in the housing sector, which typically leads to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days as the broader economy benefits from increased construction activity.
failure_condition: If the 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 50% of the instances when HOUST increases by more than 5% within two months.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in industrial production (INDPRO) by more than 1% over three months signals a strengthening supply side, which typically leads to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days as increased production capacity supports economic growth.
failure_condition: If the 60-day forward returns are negative in more than 40% of the instances when INDPRO increases by more than 1% over three months.

mechanism_narrative: When real personal consumption expenditures (RSAFS) increase by more than 1% and the unemployment rate (UNRATE) decreases by more than 0.3% within the same month, it signals a strengthening consumer demand coupled with a robust labor market, which typically leads to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
candidate_trigger: RSAFS increases > 1% and UNRATE decreases > 0.3% in 1 month
failure_condition: If the 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 60% of the instances when both conditions are met.

mechanism_narrative: A significant increase in nonfarm payrolls (PAYEMS) by more than 200,000 jobs within a month signals a strengthening labor market, which typically leads to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days as increased employment boosts consumer spending.
failure_condition: If the 5-day forward returns are negative in more than 70% of the instances when PAYEMS increases by more than 200,000 jobs within a month.

mechanism_narrative: When the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) is above 2% and the consumer price index (CPIAUCSL) increases by more than 0.5% within a month, it signals inflationary pressure coupled with tight monetary policy, which typically leads to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
candidate_trigger: FEDFUNDS > 2% and CPIAUCSL increases > 0.5% in 1 month
failure_condition: If the 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 40% of the instances when both conditions are met.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in real GDP (GDPC1) by more than 2% over a quarter signals a strengthening economy, which typically leads to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days as increased economic activity boosts corporate earnings.
failure_condition: If the 60-day forward returns are negative in more than 50% of the instances when GDPC1 increases by more than 2% over a quarter.
